pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal patches with irregular, jagged edges. The neck patches are larger and more clearly defined, showing sharp pixel-level transitions from dark centers to light margins, while flank patches appear smaller and are heavily occluded by foreground vegetation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light pathways with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent on the neck but narrows and increases in complexity toward the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, resulting from a dense, short mane.
